notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/7e275d03a4d4057dfb71c74947055be2a567076d.jpg[/img]
Warmest greetings to all [b]WANDERER: Broken Bed[/b] fans 😊 We have good news for you!

We are now still working on Act II. New stories, quests, characters, intricacies of plot and balance... Well, you know: [b]A LOT OF WORK[/b]. However, we don't forget about bugs and errors. So here we'll tell you what we've managed to find and fix 😉


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485860/WANDERER_Broken_Bed

We have tried to get rid of all the bugs that players reported. We’ve also spent quite a lot of time on additional testing afterwards. These are some of the BUGS that were very common and also have been [b]FIXED[/b]:
[list][*] Overlapping dialog with Tybalt on the H-scene with Catrine in the infirmary
[*] Closed wing was not opened after completing a certain main quest
[*] Combat with Calem didn't end after the timer expired
[*] Some fights in the dungeon didn't end even after the death of all enemies
[*] Bodies of enemies didn't disappear after killing them, thus overlapping with the HP bar of other enemies
[*] “Furry Thief” quest didn't count as finished in the jounal after completing it
[*] Creating a potion sometimes didn't count for the assignment, which broke the mini-game
[/list]
[b]HUGE[/b] thank you to all those who send bug reports on our Discord server. The game becomes better and better yet with your help ❤️

❗️ If you are still not sure where to write about bugs or other questions about the game, then welcome to our Discord: https://discord.gg/tophouse

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/49b74c63ab94f436a48b38f79872b0d72a6f6879.jpg[/img]

[h3][i]Hello everyone![/i] 💕[/h3]
Today is a historic day for all Wanderer fans: [b]v0.15 is out and Act I of our story is complete[/b]. The finish of the first act sets up for any future adventures, and for any romantic routes.

[h3]You can try out the [b]freshest build right[/b] now with all the new features:[/h3]
[list] [*] New and old H-scenes: 9 scenes in total
[*] New languages: French and Simplified Chinese
[*] New reward types for daily classes
[*] New battle cards: 9 total
[*] Choice system in dialogues
[*] Schedule system for classes
[*] 13 new main quests, 7 character quests and 6 sidequests
[*] Updated Closed Wing dungeon
[*] MC room upgrade system[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485860/WANDERER_Broken_Bed

[h2][b]And now in more detail:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]1. New and old H-scenes: 9 scenes in total[/b][/h3]
We’ll add 9 H-scenes - some of them are already familiar to you, but were cut due to various reasons, and some of them are brand new

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/ce05e9a6c6e30f0e9fcb33af6a07bc6aa0266d4e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]2. New languages: French and Simplified Chinese[/b][/h3]
Apart from Russian, English, Brazillian Portuguese, Polish and Spanish, we’ll be adding Simplified Chinese and French.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/d83cf0b81db21f4c4703facb84ed976f58a20b9c.png[/img]

[h3][b]3. New reward types for daily classes[/b][/h3]
We’ve made three new types of rewards that change every week for players to complete their classes with more enjoyment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/7b8fd2438ca89657cd2551805ff55af95abac24c.png[/img]

[h3][b]4. New battle cards: 9 in total[/b][/h3]
Since the beginning of January, we have managed to draw and add mechanics to 9 new battle cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/f959f9b8ea0ebb20240b6960c1fa8d181da3362d.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]5. Choice system in dialogues[/b][/h3]
It will appear in new quests, directing your romantic routes in this Act and influencing your relationships in the two subsequent Acts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/b3606adac537745f6e89a749add50f3b00a3fa4b.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]6. Schedule system for classes[/b][/h3]
Thanks to our new schedule system, you can spend more time studying in the Academy. It will help you get more potions, magical scrolls and battle EXP every week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/241fe52b0f085298feea53320c4b90a8773b183f.png[/img]

[h3][b]7. 13 new main quests, 7 character quests and 6 sidequests[/b][/h3]
We have written 26 new quests and have already integrated them into the game, so now you can plunge into the continuation of this wonderful story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/215881b18851683ef4bb3a31057f61fa10b421a0.png[/img]

[h3][b]8. Updated Closed Wing dungeon[/b][/h3]
We have ovehauled both the balance side of the dungeon and its visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/a1b74ee85da1a2ac44119b0ada3b92bf7934322e.png[/img]

[h3][b]9. MC room upgrade system[/b][/h3]
Thanks to this mechanic, you can finally make your pitiful mesy room into a real elite student’s den (if your budget suports it).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/964feb4f38f25b236586d009160dab4f613ff902.png[/img]

[h3][b]More content is coming: Act II, new main quest-related characters, new adventures and even more cool and sexy situations with the girls.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: DEVLOG: New Mechanic of Potioncraft Lesson ⚗️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/a98589c13a9892b5baf19977033e37916761cc9d.png[/img]
[h3][i]✍️ Well, well, well, did everybody prepare a double sheet of paper? ✍️[/i][/h3]

Today we have a new lesson - we're going to look at one of our old-school mechanics in our game. The potioncraft lesson is something our players have been familiar with for a long time. By the way, let's check your homework: did you add WANDERER: Broken Bed to your wishlist?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485860/WANDERER_Broken_Bed

[b]What potioncrafting looked like before:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/04b97942586ee53e90a104713ef802a784af54df.png[/img]

- Match-3 (or three-in-a-row) mechanic in which all you had to do was connect three identical elements.
- The player received a mark for the activity after successfully collecting the right elements on time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/9fa6f95ed8a260e0cecf35837f696235a226b1cb.png[/img]

[b]We will now explain why we decided to change it originally:[/b]
1) We were not happy using this mechanic because our wanderers were not getting proper potions training;
2) We also pay attention to feedback left on our social media and Discord;
3) Previously a student would only receive a grade for the lesson, but now they will see the results of their work immediately in their inventory;
4) It connects the lesson with the rest of the mechanics inside the game - potions can be used in battle, in trade, and maybe even when talking to girls 😏

[b]What it looks like now: [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/201cb7fb15ecbd3972423b3b08c189cbdd787192.jpg[/img]

- We have completely rejected the previous iteration. By rewriting the code, we also make to make this lesson more interesting.
- There are different elements and recipes. You combine the ingredients below according to them and the potion is ready to go!
- The player can make and get different potions (in the future). What you create with the basic instructions moves to your inventory 🤩

The recently released [b]WIP Build[/b] partially implements this feature. We are just introducing it and will improve it further later 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423230/65537b5c6b3f47f71316ce0540787dff04118d51.jpg[/img]

Well, that's it for today! We hope you had time to write down all the material of the lecture. See you soon, keep learning this material and take it right back to your wanderings 💞
